title: Microsoft 365 & Office
blurb: Word, Excel, PowerPoint: activation, sign-in, crashes, files that won't open.

remedies.title: Excel file is huge or slow to open
remedies.why: Formatting on millions of empty cells, pictures, pivot caches and hidden sheets bloat files.

steps.text: Press Ctrl+End on each sheet: if it jumps far past your data, delete those empty rows/columns and save.
Compress pictures (Picture Format › Compress Pictures).
Save as .xlsb for large data, or remove hidden sheets and old pivot caches.

remedies.title: Excel prints on too many pages or cuts columns off
remedies.why: Excel prints the used area at 100% unless told otherwise.

steps.text: Page Layout › Print Area › Set Print Area on just what you need.
In Print, Scaling › Fit All Columns on One Page; Orientation › Landscape.
View › Page Break Preview lets you drag the page edges.

remedies.title: VLOOKUP / XLOOKUP returns #N/A even though the value is there
remedies.why: Hidden spaces, numbers stored as text, or the wrong match type.

steps.text: Use exact match: last argument FALSE in VLOOKUP (XLOOKUP is exact by default).
Clean the values: TRIM() for spaces, VALUE() or Data › Text to Columns for numbers stored as text.
Check the lookup range covers the rows (use whole tables, Ctrl+T).

remedies.title: Excel won't sort or filter ("merged cells" error)
symptoms: all merged cells need to be the same size
remedies.why: Merged cells and blank rows break sorting and filtering.

steps.text: Select the range › Home › Merge & Center › Unmerge Cells; use Center Across Selection instead.
Remove blank rows inside the data, or convert it to a table (Ctrl+T).

remedies.title: Page numbers, headers or a table of contents won't behave in Word
remedies.why: Sections and fields control numbering and headers; they need updating after changes.

steps.text: Insert › Page Number › Format Page Numbers to restart or continue numbering per section.
Double-click the header › tick Different First Page or unlink "Link to Previous" for a new section.
Right-click the table of contents › Update Field › Update entire table.

remedies.title: Can't delete a blank page in Word
remedies.why: A page break, section break or the paragraph after a table pushes text onto a new page.

steps.text: Turn on ¶ (Home) to see the breaks, then delete them.
After a table at the end, select the last ¶ and set its font size to 1.

remedies.title: Convert Word to PDF, or edit a PDF in Word
remedies.why: Word saves PDFs directly and can open PDFs as editable documents (layout may shift).

steps.text: File › Save As › PDF (or Export › Create PDF).
Open a PDF in Word to edit it; check the layout afterwards.
DeskFolio converts PDFs to Word and back offline.

remedies.title: Presenter view shows on the projector (or not at all)
remedies.why: PowerPoint guessed the wrong screen for the audience.

steps.text: In the show, click ⋯ › Swap Presenter View and Slide Show (or Display Settings).
Slide Show › Monitor: choose the projector; tick Use Presenter View.
Make sure the screens are set to Extend, not Duplicate.

remedies.title: PowerPoint file is too large to email
remedies.why: Full-size photos and embedded videos make presentations huge.

steps.text: Picture Format › Compress Pictures › All pictures, Email (96 ppi) or Web (150 ppi).
File › Info › Compress Media for videos.
Share a OneDrive link instead of attaching.

remedies.title: OneNote notebook or pages are missing
remedies.why: The notebook was closed, is in another account, or pages were deleted.

steps.text: File › Open › your account's notebooks to reopen it.
History › Deleted Notes (Windows) or Notebooks › Deleted Notes (Mac) keeps deleted pages ~60 days.
Check onenote.com with the right account.

remedies.title: Spell check uses the wrong language or doesn't work
remedies.why: Text is marked with another language or "do not check spelling".

steps.text: Select all (Ctrl/⌘+A) › Review › Language › Set Proofing Language › choose yours, untick "Do not check spelling".
Set the default for new documents in the same dialog.

remedies.title: Company templates or fonts are missing in Office
remedies.why: Organisation templates come from SharePoint or a shared folder, set up by IT.

steps.text: File › New › look under Organisation or Shared tabs.
Restart Office after signing in; organisation templates load on sign-in.

remedies.escalate: IT manages company templates and fonts.
